Meta.title: 3WEEQ — A world where civilizations are told in scent
Meta.description: An immersive journey through the perfumes of Egypt, Babylon, Greece, and China — one bottle, four civilizations.

About.title: About Aweeq
About.paragraphOne: We consider perfume not through the note alone, but together with its sensory, cultural and commercial dimensions — bringing the depth of story and the craft of the perfumer onto the same ground.
About.paragraphTwo: Distinction often emerges where craft meets timing. We build our work on three principles: mastery, discipline, and trust.

Hero.headline: Where Civilizations Are Told in Scent

ui.blurb: A scent that tells the story of civilizations — discover AWEEQ in our store.

hero.tagline2: The Last Remnant of Every Civilization

egypt.headline: From the Nile, 3WEEQ Was Born
egypt.body:
In ancient Egypt, perfume was not ornament —
it was the language a civilization wrote its secrets in.
From Nile clay and temple light we learned
that scent is a memory which never ages.
Out of that inheritance we made 3WEEQ:
one vessel carrying an entire civilization.

babylon.headline: Between Two Rivers, Scent Became Art
babylon.body:
Babylon wrote its laws on clay —
and its beauty in smoke and oil.
In the hanging gardens the first rose opened,
and saffron was weighed like gold.
From that alchemy of earth and fire,
3WEEQ carries the first perfume the world knew.

greece.headline: Where Scent Learned to Think
greece.body:
In Greece, perfume left the temple for the mind —
olive groves, laurel and cypress distilled into thought.
Athletes were anointed before the games,
and philosophers wore memory on their skin.
From that pursuit of beauty and meaning,
3WEEQ carries the wisdom of scent.

china.headline: Along the Silk Road, Rises a Fragrance
china.body:
China taught perfume the patience of gardens:
tea sleeping in jars, sandalwood aging in the dark,
jasmine opening only for the night.
Incense marked the hours of emperors,
and a scent could be inherited like a name.
3WEEQ carries that measured breath.

egypt.name: Egypt
egypt.story: From blue lotus, myrrh and frankincense, the Egyptians drew the first scent ever told. A fragrance like dawn light on the banks of the Nile — clear, warm and eternal.

babylon.name: Babylon
babylon.story: In the Hanging Gardens, the first rose was plucked at dawn, and the golden threads of saffron dried under the Babylonian sun. A perfume for art and beauty.

greece.name: Greece
greece.story: In the white temples beneath the Aegean sky, flowers were consecrated as gifts to the gods, and the Greeks composed the first fragrance that told a story. A perfume like an idea.

china.name: China
china.story: The scent crossed the Silk Road carrying the secrets of the East, and rose mingled with musk and oud. A perfume that touches the sky and is kept forever.

Craftsmanship.headline: How is the rest made?
Craftsmanship.body: At the heart of nature, we choose the rarest ingredients from the finest land in the world, extracting flowers and oud slowly and carefully, in a traditional process that demands patience and expertise to turn into an eternal perfume.
